Hi Leah / Tom —

Really appreciated the conversation today. Per our call I attached a first pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that maps milestones, proposed owners, and target dates so we have something to iterate on. Highlights: 
- Objective: 6-week evaluation focused on latency and cost per inference for your core reporting pipeline
- Proposed owners: Bluewave Product (owner: Tom), Bluewave Infra (owner: Leah), Redwood PM (owner: Kimberly), Redwood CS (owner: Markus)
- Suggested kickoff: week of Apr 12 (pilot infra ready Apr 20)

Attachments: [Attachment: Bluewave_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)]

Ask: can you confirm the internal owners and whether the April windows still look realistic from your side? If priority shifted, let me know and we can slide the dates — the MAP is just to get alignment.

Next step on our end: once owners/dates are locked we'll schedule a 30-min kickoff and share the test account details.

Thanks again —
